name: Ergonomic Allen Wrench T-Handle
description: A 3D-printable T-handle grip for a 2.5mm L-shaped allen wrench. Eliminates hand pain during repetitive M3 socket head cap screw assembly. Slide the L-key in from one side — the snug slot holds it in place.

printSettings.handle: PLA or PETG | 4 Wall Loops | 40% Gyroid Infill | 0.16mm Layer Height

assemblyGuide: Print upright with hex socket opening on the build plate.
Clean hex socket: remove any elephant-foot or stringing with a 2.5mm drill bit or the wrench itself.
Slide the long arm of the 2.5mm L-key in through the slot from the side — short arm drops into the hex socket.
The snug slot holds the wrench in place during use.
If too tight, lightly sand the slot or reprint with increased channel_clearance (0.2mm).
